grammar_focus: KS17 情态动词 must/have to(义务·不得不)、should/ought to(应该·责任·建议),以及 should have done / ought to have done(过去本应做而没做)(教材 L65 Key structures)主考;SD 三组:短语动词 let off/down/in/out、agree to do vs accept sth、dress up as vs dress(辅考)
scene: 去年圣诞节,马戏团老板吉米·盖茨决定送些礼物给儿童医院。他打扮成圣诞老人,在由6个漂亮姑娘组成的“仪仗队”的陪同下,骑上一头名叫江伯的小象,沿着城里的主要街道出发了。他本该知道警察绝不会允许这类事情发生。一个警察走过来告诉吉米,他应该走一条小路,因为江伯阻碍了交通。虽然吉米同意马上就走,但江伯却拒绝移动。15个警察不得不用很大的力气把它推离主要街道。警察虽然吃了苦头,但他们还是感到很有趣。“江伯一定有好几吨重,”一个警察事后这样说,“值得庆幸的是它没让我们抬它走。当然,我们应该逮捕它,但由于它一贯表现很好,这次我们饶了它。”

grammar_card.title: must / have to / should / ought to
grammar_card.intro: KS17 表义务与建议:①must / have to = 必须、不得不(现在);过去的义务用 had to(must 没有过去式)。②should / ought to = 应该、理应(现在的建议、责任)。③过去本该做而没做:should have done / ought to have done(I should have taken a taxi 我本该打车的)。

rows: I must write some letters tonight.
I missed the train, so I had to take a taxi.
You ought to ask for permission.
should/ought to have done(过去本应做)
I should have taken a taxi.

specialRules.rule: SD 短语动词 let 各义不同:let sb off=饶恕/放过;let sb down=使失望;let sb in=让…进来;let sth out=放出去。
SD 易混词:agree to do=同意做某事;accept sth=接受某物。dress up (as)=(盛装)打扮成;dress=(一般地)穿衣。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why did the police have to push Jumbo off the main street?
options: Jumbo was holding up the traffic and refused to move
Jumbo had run away from the circus

passage: Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children's hospital. Dressed up as Santa Claus and accompanied by a 'guard of honor' of six pretty girls, he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo. He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing. A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic. Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move. Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street. The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused. 'Jumbo must weigh a few tons,' said a policeman afterwards, 'so it was fortunate that we didn't have to carry him. Of course, we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.'

stage5.stem: "I can't go to the cinema tonight; I ___ write some letters."(表'必须'——现在的义务)
stage5.stem_cn: 今晚我不能去看电影,我必须写信。

stage5.stem: "I missed the train, so I ___ take a taxi."(表过去的'不得不'——过去义务)
stage5.stem_cn: 我误了火车,所以不得不打车。

stage5.stem: "Fifteen policemen ___ push very hard to move Jumbo."(过去的'不得不'——过去义务)
stage5.stem_cn: 15个警察不得不使很大劲才把江伯推走。

stage5.stem: "He ___ come at 4 o'clock if the plane arrives on time."(表'应该'——现在的预期/建议)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果飞机准点,他应该4点到。

stage5.stem: "You ___ ask for permission before leaving the table."(表'应该'——责任)
stage5.stem_cn: 离开饭桌前你应该先请求许可。

stage5.stem: "I'm sorry I'm late. I ___ taken a taxi."(过去本应做而没做:本该打车)
stage5.stem_cn: 抱歉我迟到了,我本应该打车的。

stage5.stem: "He ___ known that the police would never allow this."(过去本该做/本该知道)
stage5.stem_cn: 他本应知道警察绝不会允许这种事。

stage5.stem: "The policeman told him he ___ gone along a side street."(过去本应做而没做:本该走小路)
stage5.stem_cn: 警察告诉他本应该走一条小路。

stage5.stem: "She ___ come to see me yesterday, but she forgot."(过去本应做而没做)
stage5.stem_cn: 她昨天本应来看我,但她忘了。

stage5.stem: "As he has a good record, we shall ___ this time."(短语动词:'饶恕、放过'他)
stage5.stem_cn: 由于他一贯表现好,这次我们就饶了他。

stage5.stem: "I expected him to help me, but he ___."(短语动词:'使我失望')
stage5.stem_cn: 我指望他帮我,但他使我失望了。

stage5.stem: "If anyone knocks when I'm out, don't ___."(短语动词:'让他进来')
stage5.stem_cn: 我不在时如果有人敲门,别让他进来。

stage5.stem: "Though Jimmy ___ to go at once, Jumbo refused to move."(同意做某事用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 虽然吉米同意马上走,但江伯拒绝挪动。

stage5.stem: "We are not allowed to ___ presents from customers."(接受某物用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 不允许我们接受顾客的礼物。

stage5.stem: "She ___ to lend me her car."(同意做某事)
"Jimmy ___ as Santa Claus."(打扮成、装扮成)
"I got up at 6, washed, and ___ quickly."(一般地'穿好衣服')
stage5.stem_cn: 我6点起床,洗漱,很快穿好衣服。

stage5.stem: "The children ___ as ghosts for the party."(为聚会盛装'打扮成')
stage5.stem_cn: 孩子们为聚会打扮成鬼的样子。
